items.title: EU Is Taking Harder Line on China’s Trade Gap as Talks Kick Off
items.description: The European Union is striking a more assertive approach to China as it heads into two days of negotiations in Beijing aimed at avoiding an economically damaging trade war.

items.title: Rupee Nears Record Low Even as RBI Signals Further Tightening
items.description: A weak monsoon is raising food-price risks, while the falling rupee is making imports more expensive.

items.title: Copper Gains with Other Metals as China Returns in Positive Mood
items.description: Copper rose alongside other metals as Chinese traders returned in a buying mood from a week-long holiday that had temporarily muted activity in Asian markets.

items.title: Singapore Bank Stocks Drop as High Bond Yields May Hit Earnings
items.description: Singapore bank shares extended declines for a second day after JPMorgan Chase & Co. warned that surging long bond yields will hurt third-quarter earnings for Southeast Asian lenders.

items.title: New Zealand’s Central Bank Chief Breman Overhauls Top Leadership
items.description: The Reserve Bank of New Zealand is recruiting two assistant governors and a chief of staff as Governor Anna Breman overhauls the central bank’s senior ranks almost a year into the job.

items.title: Asian Wheat Buyers Cut Forward Purchases as War Whipsaws Markets
items.description: Asian wheat millers are cutting forward commitments as prices soar, with Black Sea disruptions choking supplies from one of the world’s top exporting regions.

items.title: Japanese Stocks Fall as Inflation Fears Hit Cyclical Shares
items.description: Japanese stocks fell for a second day, tracking weakness in the US as persistently high oil prices revived inflation concerns and weighed on equities near record highs.

items.title: Gold Near Nine-Week Low on Prospects for Rate Hike by Year-End
items.description: Gold traded near a nine-week low as fresh tensions in the Strait of Hormuz heightened war-driven inflation concerns and investors weighed prospects for at least one more US rate hike this year.

items.title: Peru Unexpectedly Holds Rate as Price Jump Seen as Temporary
items.description: Peru unexpectedly left borrowing costs unchanged for a 13th straight month as policymakers expect a recent acceleration in inflation to prove temporary.

items.title: Fortescue Says Dispute With China’s CMRG Hits Iron Ore Sales
items.description: Iron ore miner Fortescue Ltd. said sales fell, as a standoff with state-backed buyer China Mineral Resources Group Co. over long-term supply contracts and price negotiations drags on.
